Award Contract No. PRO.0288, Electronic Bill Pay, to KUBRA Data Transfer, Ltd., for an amount not-to-exceed $2,000,000, and with a duration of five years
items.text: Award Contract No. PRO.0288, Electronic Bill Pay, to KUBRA Data Transfer, Ltd., for an amount not-to-exceed $2,000,000, and with a duration of five years, to provide bill creation, electronic bill presentment, and payment processing to the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Customer Services Bureau to process payments for water, wastewater, and power services

items.title: Approve and adopt the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission General Manager’s finding that Environmental Passive Integrated Conveyance Total Water Solution, Inc
items.text: Approve and adopt the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission General Manager’s finding that Environmental Passive Integrated Conveyance Total Water Solution, Inc. (EPIC) is a sole source for a capillary action irrigation system necessary to conduct a stormwater reuse field test; and authorize the General Manager to prescribe EPIC’s capillary action irrigation system for Contract No. WW-668, Upper Yosemite Creek Daylighting Project contract documents in conformance with San Francisco Administrative Code Section 6.73 (e)(1) and California Public Contract Code Section 3400(c)(1). This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action. SFPUC JULY 8, 2025 MINUTES Page 2 of 5

items.title: Approve an increase of $800,000 to the cost contingency for Contract No. WW-740, Various Large Diameter Sewer Inspection No. 2, with Pipe & Plant Solutions, Inc
items.text: Approve an increase of $800,000 to the cost contingency for Contract No. WW-740, Various Large Diameter Sewer Inspection No. 2, with Pipe & Plant Solutions, Inc., for a total revised cost limit of $4,041,700, with no change to the contract duration, to replenish the cost contingency and for unforeseen additional needs that may be encountered in the remainder of the contract work which may require additional large diameter sewer inspection or cleaning

items.title: Award Job Order Contract No. JOC-110, General Engineering (A-License) Construction, San Joaquin, Stanislaus, and Tuolumne Counties, Hetch Hetchy
items.text: Award Job Order Contract No. JOC-110, General Engineering (A-License) Construction, San Joaquin, Stanislaus, and Tuolumne Counties, Hetch Hetchy, in the amount not-to-exceed $5,000,000, with a guaranteed minimum task order opportunity amount of $50,000, and a duration of four years, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Robert E. Boyer Construction, Inc., to perform A-licensed general engineering construction work on San Francisco Public Utilities Commission systems and operations around Hetch Hetchy

items.title: Award professional service Contract No. PRO.0316, San Joaquin Pipeline Construction Management Staff Augmentation Services to San Joaquin Pipeline Construction Management Partners Joint Venture
items.text: Award professional service Contract No. PRO.0316, San Joaquin Pipeline Construction Management Staff Augmentation Services to San Joaquin Pipeline Construction Management Partners Joint Venture in the amount not to exceed $9,750,000 and with a duration of four years and six months, to provide construction management services for multiple San Joaquin Pipeline Projects as part of the Hetchy Capital Improvement Project. Construction management services for the construction of the San Joaquin Valve Remote Control and Monitoring project will not be authorized under this agreement unless and until environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) is completed, and this Commission has reviewed and considered the CEQA document, adopted CEQA findings and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program (MMRP) if necessary, and approves the project

items.title: Authorize the General Manager of the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission to execute on behalf of the City and County of San Francisco, a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) with the City of Daly City
items.text: Authorize the General Manager of the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission to execute on behalf of the City and County of San Francisco, a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) with the City of Daly City for the funding, construction, and operation of the Vista Grande Drainage Basin Improvement Project, subject to Board of Supervisors approval under Charter Section 9.118. The MOA would obligate the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission to help fund construction of the Vista Grande Drainage Basin Improvement Project in an amount not exceed $35,000,000 over a term of 60 months
